ctScan.note: Operator, 2026-08-07: the CT scanner at Delta is still under installation — DLT-BLD is correct, DLT-SVC is not. Not available; do not tell a patient to come in for one.

medicalCenters.note: ENTITY_REGISTRY registers all twelve Signature Centers at Delta. DLT-BLD counts NINE clinic rooms, three of them fixed to dental / orthopedics / ENT and six rotating. Twelve branded centers cannot run concurrently out of nine rooms. The twelve are a brand structure, not twelve simultaneous clinics — and HOSPITAL_DELTA.md § Never Promise already forbids any claim about which centers are 'fully running' until the operator confirms. The receptionist may state that the ecosystem has twelve centers; it may NOT tell a patient a given center is operating today. It answers from clinic schedules instead.

conflicts.subject: Delta location
conflicts.detail: Website DB seeds Delta at 'فرع المهندسين، الجيزة'. All source documents place it in Tanta, Gharbia (040 landline prefix, ADS pin, PDF title). Operator confirms: no branches, no Mohandeseen.
conflicts.resolution: DB is test data. Tanta is correct. Reseed from this file.

conflicts.subject: Delta CT scanner
conflicts.detail: DLT-SVC lists CT as an available service; DLT-BLD marks it 'تحت التجهيز'.
conflicts.resolution: RESOLVED, 2026-08-08. Operator confirms directly: the Delta CT scanner is not installed yet. DLT-BLD was correct. The receptionist must say Delta has no CT scan available; Future's CT scan is available and unaffected by this.

conflicts.subject: Delta — twelve centers vs nine clinic rooms
conflicts.detail: ENTITY_REGISTRY registers 12 centers at Delta; the building has 9 clinic rooms (3 fixed, 6 rotating).
conflicts.resolution: NOT A CONFLICT. Operator, 2026-08-07: centres do not each own a room. A room carries one centre's sign today and another's tomorrow — a centre may run five clinics one day, six the next, at different times. Room count therefore places no ceiling on centre count. The receptionist still answers from clinic SCHEDULES, never from centre count, so behaviour is unchanged; what changes is that this stopped being a contradiction to resolve.

conflicts.subject: Future ICU bed count
conflicts.detail: FUT-SVC says 25 ICU beds; FUT-BLD describes two ICU units in a building with ~23 total inpatient beds.
conflicts.resolution: OPERATOR — what is the real ICU bed count?

conflicts.subject: Future phone numbers
conflicts.detail: Footer shows two 9-digit numbers; Cairo landlines are 8 digits plus area code.
conflicts.resolution: SUPERSEDED, 2026-08-07. business/brand/CONTACT_DIRECTORY.md is the confirmed source of truth for every number a patient is given, and it lists Future's hotline as 01122224352 · 01151001177. The PDF footer numbers are not the numbers to serve, whatever they turn out to be, so the OCR question no longer gates anything. The contact directory — not this file — is what the receptionist reads for contact details.

conflicts.subject: Future outpatient capacity
conflicts.detail: FUT-SVC describes specialized outpatient clinics across many specialties; FUT-BLD lists 2 outpatient clinic rooms on the ground floor.
conflicts.resolution: NOT A CONFLICT — same rotation principle as CONF-03. Operator, 2026-08-07: two rooms can host ten clinics across different days and hours. A room is a place, not a specialty. The receptionist must therefore never infer 'this specialty is unavailable' from room count; availability comes from the clinic schedule only.
